header.shortDesc: Pregnancy is a critical time for oral health, as hormonal changes can increase the risk of gum issues, cavities, and sensitivity. SuperMouth’s dentist-designed systems for pregnancy are specially crafted to support both mother and baby’s oral health during this delicate time. Our systems work together to strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and maintain a balanced oral microbiome, ensuring a safe, effective, and comprehensive approach to oral care. Choose the system that best fits your needs: the Basic System provides minimum recommended oral care, the Plus System offers enhanced gum protection and oral health support, and the Complete System delivers the ultimate whole-mouth care for pregnancy.

left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

tiers.superText: The Complete System delivers full-mouth care designed specifically for the unique needs of pregnancy. It combines cavity prevention, enamel strengthening, advanced gum support, and microbiome balance, all while helping to reduce bad breath and sensitivity. Powered by Hydroxamin® (nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2), it provides total protection for the mother’s oral health and helps support the baby’s healthy development. This system is perfect for those who want the highest level of oral care during pregnancy, addressing every aspect of oral health.

components.name: Toothbrush
components.html: Whether you need a supercharged brush that cleans at the speed of light, a sidekick that brightens your smile, or a revolutionary manual brush that outperforms typical manual brushes by eliminating plaque up to 30 times more effectively, we have a hero for every mouth. Our dentist-invented toothbrushes feature super soft bristles and are designed with innovative bristles that conform to the natural contours of your teeth for a deep, gentle clean that supports a healthy oral microbiome.

components.name: Toothpaste
components.html: Our patent-pending toothpastes with Hydroxamin feature a proprietary blend of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, K2, prebiotics, and delicious flavors. These and other key ingredients work together to naturally strengthen enamel, whiten teeth, reduce sensitivity, and support a balanced oral microbiome, delivering safe, comprehensive care without artificial ingredients, protecting and enhancing your smile at every stage of life.

components.name: Floss
components.html: Our hydroxamin® floss uses patented expanding technology to remove over 40% more plaque than standard flosses. Its super soft floss material is gentle on the gums and comfortable around fingers. Best of all, it includes our patent-pending formulation of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins K2 & D3, and xylitol to help clean the hard-to-reach parts between the teeth.

components.name: Mouth Spray
components.html: Managing the health of the mouth is just a spritz away. Help your mouth restore to normal pH levels after meals, snacks, or drinks.  Also loaded with prebiotics to feed healthy bacteria within your oral microbiome.

components.name: Tongue Scraper
components.html: Unlike toothbrush bristles, which are designed for the hard, smooth surfaces of enamel, the tongue’s unique structure and soft surface require specialized tools for effective cleaning. This advanced tool is specifically designed to empower you with professional-grade care, featuring innovative features that ensure a thorough clean and fresh feeling.

components.name: Mouthwash
components.html: Our dentist-formulated alkaline mouthwash contains prebiotics that fight bad breath-causing bacteria and a patent-pending superpower formula, Hydroxamin® (nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2), which buffers teeth against acidic attacks.

items.q: Why is it important to use a specialized oral care system during pregnancy?
items.a: Pregnancy is a time of significant hormonal changes and other challenges that can lead to various oral health problems, with up to 74% of pregnant women experiencing these issues, according to the CDC. Our pregnancy system is specifically designed to address these challenges, ensuring that both the mother and the developing fetus are protected. The safety and efficacy of our ingredients are paramount, and our products are formulated to provide the gentle yet effective care needed during this crucial stage. Maintaining good oral health during pregnancy is essential, as it can also impact the oral health of your child.

items.q: How do SuperMouth’s pregnancy products ensure safety and efficacy?
items.a: Safety is our top priority during pregnancy, and our products are formulated with only the safest ingredients, all ranked #1 by the Environmental Working Group (EWG) for their gentle nature. Our pregnancy system not only protects your oral health but also ensures that these products are safe for both you and your developing baby. The efficacy of our products has been tested and proven to help prevent and manage the common oral health issues that arise during pregnancy.

items.q: How long does a System last?
items.a: Each System is designed to last 90 days — 3 full months — for the average user. Subscriptions deliver a fresh box every 90 days, with monthly or quarterly payment options, and you can adjust your delivery schedule anytime if your family uses more or less.

items.q: Why should I choose a system versus buying individual products during pregnancy?
items.a: Our pregnancy system is curated by leading dentists and medical experts to provide a comprehensive solution that addresses the unique needs of pregnant women. By choosing a system, you ensure that every product works together to protect and enhance your oral health during this important time. Additionally, the system offers the best value and includes educational content to help you navigate your oral care journey safely and effectively. A subscription ensures you never run out of essential products, so your oral health is consistently supported throughout your pregnancy.

items.q: How can I get a head start on my baby’s oral care while I’m still pregnant?
items.a: As you prepare for your baby’s arrival, you can also explore our Teething - 24 Months stage products and educational content. This early exploration allows you to get a head start on your newborn’s oral care, ensuring that you are well-prepared to protect and nurture your baby’s developing teeth and gums from the very beginning.

items.q: How does my oral health during pregnancy affect my child’s oral health?
items.a: A mother’s oral health during pregnancy has a direct impact on the oral health of her child. Various oral health problems can affect the development of your baby’s teeth and gums. Our pregnancy system is designed to help you maintain optimal oral health, which in turn supports your baby’s overall health and development.
